pages.finding: SekI cytological/chromosomal mitosis/meiosis and strongly simplified gene-gene-product-trait model; DNA construction/identical replication, protein synthesis and point mutation are deepened in SekII.
Mutation treated only phenomenologically/descriptively in SekI; molecular genetics follows in SekII. Exact table clause explicitly excludes molecular genetic consideration.

operatorFindings.analysieren: Important components/properties for a question; pedigree source also demands explanatory consequences, not only classification.
operatorFindings.anwenden: Use known knowledge/method on something new; provided worked examples do not count as new learner performance.
operatorFindings.erklären: Make fact comprehensible by rules/laws/causes; causal templates meet this when relationship is learner-generated.
operatorFindings.erläutern: Use added information to illustrate and clarify; simple description/labels alone do not meet explanatory family-tree or reproduction-comparison clauses.
operatorFindings.deuten: Place facts in an explanatory context; family resemblance remains an indication, not certain genetic proof.
operatorFindings.nennen: State facts/concepts/elements without explanations; all five named vertebrate groups remain normative breadth.
operatorFindings.classificationAndDistinguishing: Source table itself supplies ordnen/einordnen/unterscheiden as literal operators; no glossary entry is invented.
operatorFindings.bestimmenCaution: Generic appendix numerical calculate/determine entry does not override biological species identification explicitly demanded by EG1; use actual source context.
operatorFindings.EN: Biology bilingual appendix gives explain=erklären, illustrate=erläutern, interpret=deuten, name/list/enumerate=nennen; semantic task performance governs translation.

sourceLiteralVsSummary: Candidate actual clauses are confirmed literal modulo layout dehyphenation; conceptual reasoning in README and this review is explicitly paraphrase.
globalScientificClarification: Selection does not produce new alleles/variants. It changes, and in special cases can maintain, variation already present. The unqualified 9f DE/EN list treats origin and selection alike and therefore remains misleading/incorrect as a learning target. This clarification does not approve its current body.
